name: seven-rh
description: Seven RH — SIRH vanilla JS + Supabase. Pas de bundler ni de framework de test : les scripts ci-dessous n'utilisent que Node lui-même.

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check data.js && node --check supabase-client.js && node --check qrcode.js
scripts.test: node tests/workflow-resolution.test.js && node tests/leave-types-backfill.test.js && node tests/security-definer-grants.test.js && node tests/module-gating.test.js
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test
